tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and frame-table ground. The app's default canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Explorer sidebar, code and payload blocks, table header rows. Sits one step below surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs and cards that float above surface. In light it is white and relies on line plus shadow-pop to separate.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and list-item hover. Never for selection; selection uses trace-tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, frame IDs, values the engineer reads: on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised (18.9:1 light, 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels, secondary cells and timestamps: on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised (6.7:1 light, 7.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Not for running text. Placeholders, disabled labels, input borders and icons that must still be found (3.6:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panes, rows and toolbar sections. Decorative only; never the sole cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Column resize handles, table outer border, card edge on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects and secondary buttons at rest. Aliases ink-faint so it keeps 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: The brand colour: logo mark, primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected row stripe, the highlighted byte. As text it reads on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised (7.4:1 light, 7.8:1 dark). Tuned from the violet the app already used.

tokens.name: trace-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a trace fill. Dark theme flips to ink-dark because the dark trace is light (7.4:1 and 7.8:1).

tokens.name: trace-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab, highlighted byte range, drop target. ink and trace both read on it.

tokens.name: trace-line
tokens.usage: Border of a selected card or drop target, the underline of an active tab. Pair with trace-tint.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every control, offset 2px from the control. Solid, never a glow (7.4:1 light, 7.8:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: Confirmed DTCs, negative responses (7F), bus errors, destructive buttons. Always with a word or glyph. As text on surface 5.6:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: fault-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a fault badge or row. fault reads on it (4.8:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending DTCs, timeouts, patched or simulated responses, unsaved changes. Always with a word or glyph. As text on surface 5.4:1 light, 11:1 dark.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warn badge or row. warn reads on it (4.8:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Positive responses, connected adapter, passing checks, cleared DTCs. Always with a word or glyph. As text on surface 5.4:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an ok badge or row. ok reads on it (4.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a solid fault, warn or ok fill (the destructive button, a solid status chip). White in light, ink-dark in dark.

tokens.name: byte-id
tokens.usage: The arbitration ID column and the ID part of a frame literal (the part before #).

tokens.name: byte-service
tokens.usage: The service byte (SID) of a diagnostic payload, set in data-strong.

tokens.name: byte-data
tokens.usage: Ordinary payload bytes.

tokens.name: byte-padding
tokens.usage: ISO-TP padding bytes (AA, 55, 00 fill) and unused DLC slots. Present but quiet.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Fixed white in both themes: the mark on the app-icon tile, text on a trace-light print background. Never for UI text.

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed near-black in both themes: the ink lockup on print and on light photography. Never for UI text.

families.display: "Schibsted Grotesk", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: Know exactly what the ECU said.
styles.usage: Website hero and the cover. One or two lines, never inside the app.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Website section titles, deck slide titles.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark when it must be live text (app header, document footer). Martian Mono, uppercase; otherwise use the SVG. The only place Martian Mono is used.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and dialog titles in the app. The app's --fs-5.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Connect an adapter to start a live session.
styles.usage: Running text in dialogs, docs and empty states. The app's --fs-4.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default control and menu text. The app's --fs-3.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column headers and group labels. The app's --fs-1. Always uppercase with this tracking.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Frame table cells, payload bytes, config values. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Service IDs, arbitration IDs and any byte the engineer should see first.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Shell commands and YAML in docs and the website.

styles.name: frame
styles.usage: A single frame literal shown large: website, docs callouts, slides.

spacing.note: A 2px scale up to 16px for the data UI, then 8px steps. The app's --sp-1 … --sp-8 map to space-1 … space-8 unchanged.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Byte gap inside a payload, badge inner padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline badges and icons, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding vertical, gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding horizontal, button padding vertical, gap in toolbars.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Input padding horizontal.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, button padding horizontal.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Rare; between a heading and its list.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Toolbar padding, dialog padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a dialog or docs page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website and docs section padding; the cover pattern pitch.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Website hero top and bottom.

radius.note: Tight corners. The UI is a measuring instrument, not a toy; radius never exceeds 6px on a UI element.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Byte cells, badges, table selection stripe.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dialogs, the favicon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and count pills only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs on surface-raised. The only shadow in the system; cards and panels use line instead.
